outcome: macro- and microscopic description of umbilical cord
cellular concentration of umbilical cord progenitor cells
cohort: The participants were seven captive agoutis (cutias) used for collection of umbilical cords.
finding: The study described the structural characteristics of agouti umbilical cords at different gestational stages and demonstrated a successful protocol for isolating a high cellular concentration of umbilical cord progenitor cells.
mod_finding: Umbilical cords were collected via caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Umbilical cords were collected at 30, 35, 50, 75, and 100 days postcoital, and in the third stage of gestation.
gest_age: 30, 35, 50, 75, and 100 days postcoital; third stage of gestation
